# Datums and transformations to WGS 84 most often met

*Generated by `scripts/build-datums.py` from EPSG v12.029 (2025-10-02), as carried by PROJ 9.8.1. Live records: epsg.org. Don't edit by hand: rerun the script.*

For each datum: the live (not deprecated) transformations to WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), best stated accuracy first, up to eight. Choose by the site's position (the area of use must contain it), then accuracy; see SKILL.md, section 4. "grid" means the transformation needs a grid file; "concatenated" chains several operations. Accuracy is EPSG's stated figure in metres; blank means not stated.

## WGS 84 itself

WGS 84 (datum EPSG:6326) is an ensemble of 8 realisations, accurate as a whole to about 2 m. Good enough for screening; record the realisation and epoch for survey-grade work.
